mission: Hostile downstream recreation court: determine whether V550 position-conditioned empirical response meaning is recreated, reconstructed, regenerated, approximated, substituted, directly reused, or recoverable downstream through V551, V551J, V552, V552J, V553-V558 and V3.

canonical_test_object.unary_form: P(response=r | exact observed conditioning predicate, source, wave/time, geography)
canonical_test_object.intersection_form: P(response=r | A AND B, source, wave/time, geography)

self_correction.prior_pass_primary_question: Artifact consumption classification into execution/adjudication/forensic/duplicate roles.
prior_pass_useful_support: Direct-DAG reuse is distinct from serial republishing.
Producer identity, permission, typed negative authority, provenance and reference closure are terminally important.
V557/V558 are producer-preserving publication/resolution infrastructure rather than semantic recreation engines.
Current artifact existence is not proof of terminal semantic authority.
previously_unanswered_original_mission_q: Whether actual V550 position-response conditionals survive or reappear in V551.
Whether ddm_v551_conditional.py is semantically equivalent to the V550 conditional object.
Whether V551J reconstructs unary or intersectional position-response distributions.
Whether V552 actually consumes its optional conditional_determinicity argument.
Whether V552 position_conditioning_profile preserves respondent conditional distributions.
Whether V553+ direct reuse implies that an exact conditional object actually exists and is repository-reachable.
Whether V3 generated positions or structural metadata can lawfully substitute for missing empirical conditional meaning.

implementation_findings.finding: indicator_answer_matrix_rows cross-tabulates exact indicator values against response_value_normalized and emits unweighted/weighted counts and shares for each response cell.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Concrete unary respondent conditional sufficient-stat surface.

implementation_findings.finding: position_distribution emits marginal position-field/value counts and shares only.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: P(position), not P(response|position).

implementation_findings.finding: secondary_indicator_summary computes a joint primary-secondary key and conditional entropy/secondary gain but does not emit the complete A AND B response-cell distribution.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Lossy higher-order dependence summary.

implementation_findings.finding: APPROVED_DIRECT_TABLES contains only answer_distribution and country_answer_distribution; certification requires direct_relation_response lane. indicator_answer_matrix is routed through derived_determinicity and is therefore excluded from canonical signed atoms.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Dedicated V550 conditional matrix is not recreated in canonical V551 atom path.

implementation_findings.finding: Atom schemas contain position_field, position_value, subject_position_signature, position_conditioning, position_modifiers and conditional_strata_weights, but schema vocabulary does not override the actual source-table/lane exclusion.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Position-related fields are not proof of preserved IAM conditional meaning.

implementation_findings.finding: Alternate conditional compiler consumes derived_determinicity rows with support gating and emits response measurements/provenance, but omits explicit position_field/value or indicator predicate identity from the semantic row and conditional_id.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Lossy approximation; exact interpretation requires dereferencing the original V550 source row.

implementation_findings.finding: Packets preserve component/pattern/association IDs and evidence lineage and may carry joint response patterns, but do not recreate exact structural-position predicate x response crosstabs.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Metadata/evidence linkage plus a different joint semantic object.

implementation_findings.finding: build_v552_structural_outputs accepts conditional_determinicity but does not consume it; canonical outputs are constructed from atoms, directional coverage and adjudication, and conditional_determinicity_status_audit is emitted empty.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Alternate V551 conditional lane does not affect canonical V552 meaning.

implementation_findings.finding: position_conditioning_profile is a rollup of already-created pressure observations keyed by subject_position_signature and position_conditioning.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Pressure rollup, not original respondent conditional response topology.

implementation_findings.finding: Packet/fact association supplies exact-scope linking, admission/use permission, blockers and lineage without respondent-level recomputation.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Metadata/admission only for the target conditional.

implementation_findings.finding: Pinned canonical intake consumes V552/V552J structural and temporal-handoff material, not V550 indicator_answer_matrix or the V551 alternate conditional index as respondent conditional authority.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: No recreation.

implementation_findings.finding: Structural affordance/applicability semantics operate on already-authorized structural bases and position requirements.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Different semantic object.

implementation_findings.finding: Mediation route/condition semantics describe actor-independent structural pathways, not empirical respondent distributions.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Different semantic object.

implementation_findings.finding: Interaction and attractor-prerequisite topology composes structural routes and cannot infer missing respondent distributions from coexistence, direction, source, target or time.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Different semantic object.

implementation_findings.finding: Current renderer-boundary implementation does not reconstruct V550 conditionals; accepted CAN-003 publication law can preserve an exact existing producer object but creates no structural-domain semantics.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: No recreation; conditional direct reuse is possible only after explicit admission of an existing exact object.

implementation_findings.finding: Current runtime gate is not a conditional estimator; accepted CAN-004 repository law indexes/link already-valid producer-preserving publication and explicitly forbids repair or inference of missing semantic dependencies.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Exact direct reuse only for existing admitted objects; otherwise no recreation.

implementation_findings.finding: Generated structural-position authority explicitly forbids geography, raw prevalence, demographic association, defaults or plausibility from manufacturing actor position/probability and requires separately governed distribution authority when such semantics are needed.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Missing empirical conditional cannot be inferred from actor generated position or structural metadata.

implementation_findings.finding: An already-lawful generated position may be bound into a Phase-B ContextResolver query against the same immutable repository; the resolver evaluates already-governed predicates and may not create/backfill position or semantic authority.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Can select an existing position-conditioned object but cannot reconstruct a missing one.

implementation_findings.finding: Availability/opportunity/encounter/exposure and actor knowledge remain distinct from structural prior and objective structural causation.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Lived/epistemic semantics are different objects, not respondent conditional evidence.

implementation_findings.finding: Respondent-grain substrate preserves respondent alignment, response, source/wave/country, weights and semantics; exact recomputation additionally requires the exact conditioning columns to survive on the same respondent rows, which the required-column contract does not universally guarantee for all INDICATOR_FIELDS.
implementation_findings.semantic_effect: Potential recomputation source, not current downstream recreated authority.

equivalence_tests.name: Intersectional conditional non-identifiability from unary conditionals
equivalence_tests.implication: Unary conditionals, marginals, entropy/gain summaries, packet co-membership and structural metadata cannot determine P(Y|A AND B).

equivalence_tests.name: Alternate V551 conditional predicate-identity test
equivalence_tests.construction: Two derived source rows may carry different exact conditioning predicates while the V551 alternate output schema contains no explicit condition field/value. Exact interpretation then depends on dereferencing source_row_hash back to the V550 row.
equivalence_tests.reason: The compiler retains measurements/provenance but does not recreate the predicate as machine-readable semantic content.

equivalence_tests.name: V552 optional conditional input causality test
equivalence_tests.construction: Hold atoms, directional coverage and directional adjudication fixed while vary conditional_determinicity.
equivalence_tests.necessary_result: Canonical V552 outputs remain identical because conditional_determinicity is not read by build_v552_structural_outputs.

direct_dag_finding.accepted_law: Later stages may directly reuse producer-owned earlier objects and CAN-003/CAN-004 may preserve/link exact admitted producer objects without semantic re-ID.

microdata_recovery_finding.condition: The same respondent-grain evidence must retain exact condition variable(s), response, respondent alignment, weights/weight-status, source, wave, geography, missing/special treatment and provenance/authority.
microdata_recovery_finding.important_distinction: Potential recomputability does not mean the conditional is currently reconstructed or terminally reachable as authoritative semantic state.

adp009_test.rationale: ADP-009 forbids statistically prevalent, geographically plausible, demographically associated or convenience-based position generation; CAN-006 permits only exact caller-owned generated-position bindings against existing repository objects. Neither authority licenses synthesis of missing population response statistics.

1_unary_v550_conditional_response_meanin.detail: The exact V550 indicator_answer_matrix may be directly reused if preserved and governed, but canonical V551 excludes it; alternate V551 conditional loses explicit predicate identity; V552 ignores the alternate conditional input; later stages operate on different semantic objects.

2_higher_order_joint_conditional_meaning.detail: V550 secondary analysis keeps dependence summaries rather than the full intersectional response distribution; V551J joint patterns are different objects; the A/B equivalence fixture proves unary marginals cannot identify P(response|A AND B).

3_apparent_recreation_merely_metadata.detail: Many position-related fields and packet/fact/binding identities are metadata only. V552 position_conditioning_profile and V551 alternate conditional are lossy derivations rather than pure metadata, but neither is exact recreation.

4_lost_meaning_recoverable_only_by_retur.detail: Recovery requires respondent-grain condition-response alignment or another lossless equivalent sufficient-stat table. A new governed recomputation is then required.

5_accepted_553plus_direct_dag_solves_sem.detail: Direct-DAG/CAN-003/CAN-004 can preserve and expose an existing exact producer object but cannot create a missing object, restore lost predicate identity or infer a missing semantic dependency.

decisive_findings: V550 indicator_answer_matrix is an actual unary position-response crosstab; position_distribution and determinicity summaries are not equivalent substitutes.
Canonical V551 signed atoms exclude indicator_answer_matrix because only direct_relation_response rows from answer_distribution/country_answer_distribution are approved direct tables.

The alternate V551 conditional compiler consumes derived-determinicity rows but omits explicit condition predicate identity from its emitted conditional object, so it is lossy rather than exact recreation.
V552 accepts conditional_determinicity syntactically but never reads it; position_conditioning_profile is only a rollup of structural pressure observations.
V551J/V552J provide joint/evidence and packet-fact linkage but do not reconstruct unary or intersectional structural-position response distributions.
V557/V558 direct-DAG publication/resolution can exactly reuse only an already-existing admitted producer object; it is transport, not semantic repair.

ADP-009/CAN-006 forbid using generated position, prevalence, geography, demographic association or structural metadata to fill missing empirical conditional meaning; exact recovery otherwise requires retained respondent-grain evidence or an equivalent lossless sufficient-stat table.
unresolved_blockers: The shared respondent-substrate required-column contract does not by itself guarantee retention/publication of every V550 INDICATOR_FIELD, so exact microdata recomputability must be verified per source/build rather than assumed globally.

Accepted generic CAN-003/CAN-004 publication law can package earlier producer objects, but the inspected terminal mixed-producer root architecture does not itself establish V550 indicator_answer_matrix as an automatically admitted runtime collection; explicit publication/admission would be required for exact direct reuse.
